Bolster your dark legions with this fierce Slave Infantry unit for Dark Elf armies, perfect for epic fantasy wargames!

This set includes 23 unique and dynamic Amazon warrior miniatures, carefully designed for both 10mm and 15mm scales. Each pose brings variety and character to your tabletop army, ensuring your forces look alive and menacing—even at small scale.

For 10mm scale, you’ll get two printing options:

Individual miniatures
Strips of 6 models
Also included are 3 special command figures:

Squad Leader

23 distinct poses, full of energy and fine detail suitable for small-scale printing.

The Excess God: Demon Chariots 5.0 bundle delivers a brutal and decadent vision of war at 10mm scale, featuring three distinct demon chariot models forged to embody speed, excess, and merciless destruction on the battlefield. Each chariot is designed with aggressive silhouettes, dynamic motion, and exaggerated details that remain crisp and readable even at small scale, making them ideal centerpieces for dark fantasy or infernal-themed armies.

Every model in this bundle is carefully optimized for high-quality resin printing. All miniatures come manually pre-supported using Lychee Slicer, with supports placed by hand to ensure reliable prints, minimal cleanup, and maximum preservation of fine details. The geometry is engineered to reduce unnecessary islands while maintaining structural strength, allowing for efficient and consistent printing across multiple copies.

These miniatures are created for miniature-agnostic tabletop games, giving players full freedom to use them across a wide range of custom systems and settings. They are not intended to replace, replicate, or act as proxies for any commercially licensed miniature ranges. For non-agnostic games, the use of original, officially licensed components is always recommended. Tordominis does not condone or support piracy in any form.

All distribution rights for these models are reserved exclusively by Tordominis. Official releases are available only through the Tordominis store on MyMiniFactory and through authorized physical miniature sellers. Any unauthorized sharing or distribution of these files, including via third-party websites, file-sharing platforms, or messaging services, is strictly prohibited.

This bundle is built for players and collectors seeking uncompromising detail, dark grandeur, and battlefield presence at epic scale.

Demon beasts for warmaster both with and without supports using Schlossbauer's awesome sun demon. Note that they fit two on a stand instead of the regular three. I wanted something bigger looking and not necessarily the exact same as each and every other army regarding formations and unit sizes. These are chaos demons!

10mm demon army
See my collections for the other units; I have a unit for each of the roles in warmaster revolution and a couple of heroes. Note that this army does not inherently match one of the big four chaos gods by design, as I find them dreadfully boring.

Supports
The supports are auto generated by Prusa. Be very careful when removing the support from its mouth. I initially removed the circular base, then re-added my own after realizing this model would be likely to break from a stand without one. I call my artful addition "A gentle spring breeze".

Why?
I just got a 3d printer and was looking to get into warmaster with some friends when I noticed that there is no ready to print demon army yet. Given my 0-level modelling skills I instead decided to use existing models to create the army; this unit is one of the outcomes of this project.

Disclaimer
To be sure: none of these models are actually mine. I am a complete hack blundering his way through blender; all I can do is resize models, fatten segments and add cylinders (you may spot some of my handiwork on other models, or here!).

This collection of previously released models has been re-scaled and tidied up and will be featured in one of the two starter sets for our current Kickstarter campaign: [Pocket-Tactics Series 2: Coils of Chaos](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/292543184/pocket-tactics-series-2-coils-of-chaos)

*Hailing from the Bloodlands to the barren north, the Dreth are hulking, cyclopean marauders descended from the demons that once haunted this desert realm.*

All models are supplied without bases and print 100% support free in FDM (with minimal supports required when printing in resin), are scaled for standard miniature gaming (30mm scale), and 15mm scale versions are included as well!

This set includes 6 miniatures (Half-Dreth Raider, Dreth Hurler, Dreth Marauder, Dreth Champion, Dreth Warlock, and Dreth Warlord) plus a wasteland base for either scale. Stat cards for our [OpenTactics](http://www.illgottengames.net/opentactics) free (and open source) wargaming system are also included as a PDF.

For those of you thinking about [supporting us on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/illgottengames?fan_landing=true), our patrons get special weekly model releases, access to new storefront releases and our entire back catalog, plus licensing options to sell printed versions of our designs.

Each model has been sculpted anew from the ground up, not just refined but completely reimagined, forged to embody the dark essence of excess and corruption.
